Brushes sold at this place are for makeup, painting and…

I stumbled across Nakachan in Hiroshima, and while the wait was a bit long, it was well worth it. The Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki was absolutely spot on – so flavourful and perfectly made. One of the best meals we had for our trip! Glad we had Nakachan for our last meal in Hiroshima Service was superb. Patient and welcoming staff even if we were foreigners 😊 Get the steak, sea urchin & watercress, yakisoba!!! The best 👍

I was walking past on the streets and saw streams of locals going into this place so I followed and I'm so glad I did. The food was incredible!!! Super nice staff and cosy atmosphere and they even have menus in English which was very nice. I love, love this place.

rv.t: I had a delicious and utterly relaxing visit here on a Saturday morning. I was away from home and came knowing I needed to join a group phone call. I was just hoping the space would work out, and it exceeded my expectations. The restaurant was very full of other enthusiastic Saturday morning breakfast eaters, but when I mentioned my phone call the hostess offered me a lovely space in their armchair sunroom where it…

Staff was incredibly kind and food was delicious! The prices were also very reasonable, highly recommend checking out Corie’s Cafe!! Such a sweet spot and so lucky to have something like this in Duvall!! Can’t wait to come back!

Great people, amazing place, and delicious food! The atmosphere was fantastic. One of my dishes came with cream, which I don’t eat—I had ordered it by mistake. The staff was incredibly kind and replaced it at no extra charge, even offering it to my friends instead of wasting it. Highly recommend! !

231.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 7:00（金）

232.aj: アメリカ合衆国 〒98361 ワシントン州 ベンチ湖

rv.t: Not worth it at all. 25 minute hike in a muggy forest to the lake which doesn’t even have views of Mt Rainier. I imagine when the water level was lower you might have been able to walk around the lake to see Rainier from a different angle. But as for now, there is a 2x2m patch of mud you can stand and view the lake from, from the trail. And cannot see Rainier. Not worth it unfortunately :(

For the best view of Mount Rainier @bench lake in better lighting and frame, I recommend visiting during the early hours of the day, preferably around sunrise. The morning light can enhance the beauty of the mountain and provide better opportunities for photography.
Small lake on way to Snow lake. We saw a male bear by Bench lake, on way to Snow lake.

rv.t: Kit, Selena, & Noah were so friendly as well as professionals in being polite and helpful. So was the Manager. Stores, your’s or other’s, are often filled with non friendly, smiling people like these. This made be believe we should shop here again. This is, I’m sure your goal. Thank you for possibly recognizing them as so special. I’m sure there are more however, these are the ones I particularly came in contact…

This is not a welcoming store. I've had multiple interactions with the pharmacists, and each time they act like they own you. The last straw was my recent encounter with the cashier who was sitting at the register with dragon queen style makeup. Not judging, just mentioning it in case managers want to figure out who it was and maybe train her better. I couldn't remember the phone number for my loyalty program. I…

Man at self check out argued with me saying I intentionally didn’t pay for a bag for 5 minutes when I accidentally clicked the 0 option for the bags at self check out. I always pay for the bag if I haven’t brought one of my own reusable bags. Left a very bitter taste in my mouth. When I said sorry it was an accident and that I would pay for the bag he ended up dropping the act and let me go. I don’t understand why…

234.a: Kitanda Espresso & Acai - Redmond, 16349 NE 74th St Ste 120, Redmond, WA 98052

234.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious acai bowls, coffee, and Brazilian cheese bread, with many gluten-free options. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, and the comfortable atmosphere. Some reviews mention the service can be inconsistent.

rv.t: Absolutely incredible açaí! The fruit was super fresh and delicious - I built my own bowl and got bananas, strawberries, honey, and coconut flakes and it was so delicious! Their chai was very good as well and they have dairy free options.

The BEST gluten-free and cost-effective breakfast in PNW. The Acai bowls are delicious and only $9, and all the cheesy bread is gluten-free. Turn it into a sandwich too and it’s only $4. I swear by this place.

The food and coffee were delicious, and we got our order pretty quickly. The açaí bowl was very cold with frozen berries, which was a bit disappointing, though it might actually be nice on a hot summer day. The place is very cozy, and we’ll definitely come back!

rv.t: Edit: the owners are not very supportive of frequent customers and can be quite condescending. We have always made sure to keep ordering multiple times if we stay long hours (spent hundreds in a week), but they've held it against us despite that. Avoid being frequent here. Baristas are still kind and food is good. This is probably the best Qamaria across the country! I've been here three times in a row and they were…

This was my first time visiting a Yemeni coffee establishment, and it was a very pleasant surprise. Unlike your standard Starbucks, this coffee establishment was pretty bustling behind the counter and restaurant floor. There were many baristas. The atmosphere is modern casual and a bit on the louder side. There was plenty of comfortable seating, tables, couches and high back chairs unlike Starbucks. I’m unfamiliar…

Went there recently and it was pretty busy. Had to wait about 10 minutes to order and another 10 minutes to get the food, so expect a bit of a wait during busy hours. I tried the honeycomb bread and thought it was okay, I don’t really get the hype around it, maybe it’s more about how it looks? Still, it tasted pretty good with tea or coffee. The rose milk cake and caramel cake was good though, and I enjoyed that…

236.a: Log Boom Park, 17415 61st Ave NE, Kenmore, WA 98028
236.aj: ログ・ボーン・パーク 17415 61st Ave NE, Kenmore, WA 98028 アメリカ合衆国
236.ed: Visitors say this park features a lovely sandy beach, a playground, and a pier, making it ideal for families and children. They also highlight the well-maintained walking and biking trails, which connect to longer routes and offer opportunities for bird watching. Guests mention the availability of restrooms, drinking fountains, and dog waste bags, along with convenient kayak and paddleboard…

rv.t: Beautiful and well maintained park but very crowded and hardly any parking even on a weekday. The trail is very nice as well. Great views too. Bathrooms are available. Drinking water fountain available. Safe to bike & skate on the walking trail. People were courteous on the trail, picking up after their dogs. Doggie poop bags available on the trail as well. Covered picnic area available but always busy & taken…

Winter visit this local park in Kenmore, beautiful lake view. Saw people walk their dogs on leashes. Should be a good place for family and friends to gather in warmer days. Also good to just have a break facing lake Washington for a peaceful day.

I stop by this park every time I bike around Lake Washington. It has become a wonderful place to gather and enjoy summer in Seattle. The park features covered areas for group events, a playground, a beach, and convenient boat access.

rv.t: From town, the pavement is in good shape to this trailhead, all things considered. You will drive another 3.7 miles along a dirt gravel road. This is manageable without 4 wheel drive! There is minor washboarding but some ruts made from rocks in which you’d want a vehicle with some clearance like an SUV or Jeep. A lower car would scrape bottom. Some blind corners and no guard rail, just be careful and it was really…

This parking lot leads to Stuart Lake Trail and Colchuck Lake Trail, as well as Colchuck Lake. There isn’t a large parking capacity, so I suggest getting there very early. The congestion is worth the trails. The views on these trails are amazing.

Unhinged animals at this trailhead. It is always disgusting. Just look at the pleading signs in the bathroom. An insane amount of disrespectful people do this trail. I feel terrible for the poor Forest Service rangers that have to deal with it

238.ed: Low-key, snug restaurant serving hearty meat & veggie plates, plus rice bowls & beer.
238.edj: ボリュームのある牛肉と野菜の炒め物、ご飯、ビールを提供する、落ち着いた雰囲気のこぢんまりとした店。

rv.t: Great!

経堂に来たので、何か美味しいものが無いかと思い、気になってこの博多鉄板焼肉のお店へ来ました。 オープン前にはすでに行列。人気ぶりが伺えます。 今日はそれほどお腹が空いていなかったので、1人前とライス小を注文。 他のお客さんはダブル、トリプルにめし大とボリュームがありそうな注文がたくさん通ってました(^◇^;) 10分ほどで料理が到着！ 豚肉とキャベツを炒めた鉄板で提供されました。 食べ方の説明通りに鉄板を木の棒で傾けて、油汁に辛味噌を付けて食べると、辛味噌との味が絶妙で、ご飯がどんどん進みます。 少しお肉が硬すぎるのが残念ですが、この価格でこのボリュームと考えると十分かなと思います。 これで牛肉バージョンもあると嬉しいですね。 ご馳走様でした。

平日ランチタイムにお邪魔しました。知り合いの九州マニアの床屋のマスターから教えられ、遂にやっと念願叶って大食漢の甥っ子とお邪魔しました。 人気店にたまにある横柄な対応を覚悟してましたが、スタッフの皆さんはとても親切フレンドリー✨️気持ち良く食事させていただきました。 連れて来なかった家族のために持ち帰りをお願いしましたが、あの！辛味噌も、平日ならではのご飯も付けてくださり、ラップをして汁漏れに配慮して新聞紙で包んでくださり安心して、尚且つ旨さを家族に持ち帰ることが出来ました。 次は時間をずらして飲みながら堪能させていただきます。

rv.t: This is a very popular restaurant where you’ll see the crowd continuously coming in. The famous soup pasta has a nice home cooked feel to it which my mom can prepare. My mom is an above average cook though. The sauce was really generous but there was nothing very special on the spaghetti itself as well. The pizza was decent and nothing to shout about.

Visiting Homu’s Pasta (ホームズパスタ) in Shibuya, Tokyo was a delightful experience for me as an Asian tourist. The restaurant has a warm and cozy atmosphere, making it a comfortable place to relax after exploring the busy streets of Shibuya. The pasta dishes are rich in flavor and beautifully presented. I tried their famous creamy seafood pasta, and it was absolutely delicious—perfectly cooked noodles with a generous…
Super Delicious!! So far THE best around Shibuya! Recommend the Tuna and Tomato Cream! Also the Tomato Mozzarella!
